title: Global Surveillance Under the Lens: Reconstructing Passive Dolev-Yao Intruders
abstract: arXiv:2611.07170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Global surveillance systems record large volumes of network traffic for retrospective analysis, but packet captures alone reveal little about protocol-level semantics. This paper presents an automated, specification-guided methodology for reconstructing passive Dolev-Yao intruder executions from captured network traffic and validating the reconstructed executions against a formal protocol specification. The framework takes a PCAP capture, an AnBx specification, and the associated deployment metadata; it extracts Java-serialised objects from TCP streams, reconstructs protocol sessions and channel-to-step assignments, and generates a passive intruder that evaluates the Dolev-Yao derived checks produced by the AnBx compiler. translated_title: 镜头下的全球监控：重构被动Dolev-Yao入侵者
translated_abstract: 全球监控系统记录大量网络流量用于回溯分析，但仅凭数据包捕获难以揭示协议层面的语义。本文提出了一种自动化的、规范指导下的方法论，用于从捕获的网络流量中重构被动Dolev-Yao入侵者的执行过程，并依据形式化协议规范对重构的执行进行验证。该框架以PCAP捕获文件、AnBx规范及相关部署元数据作为输入；从TCP流中提取Java序列化对象，重构协议会话以及信道与步骤之间的映射关系，并生成一个被动入侵者来评估AnBx编译器产生的Dolev-Yao推导检查。本文解决了三个重构挑战：TCP流中包含多个序列化对象和对象引用的问题、交织连接与并发协议会话之间映射的歧义问题，以及语义验证问题。
tldr: 本文提出一种自动化的规范指导方法，能够从PCAP捕获的网络流量中重构被动Dolev-Yao入侵者的执行过程，并依据AnBx形式化协议规范进行验证，同时解决了TCP流中对象重构、并发会话映射歧义和语义验证三大挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an automated, specification-guided methodology to reconstruct passive Dolev-Yao intruder executions from captured PCAP network traffic and validate them against formal AnBx protocol specifications, addressing three key challenges: extracting multiple Java-serialized objects from TCP streams, resolving ambiguity in mapping interleaved connections to concurrent protocol sessions, and semantic validation.
